title: Slow detectConflictingPaths causes Error: Static page generation for <PATH> is still timing out after 3 attempts

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```
Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: x64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 21.6.0: Sun Nov  6 23:31:16 PST 2022; root:xnu-8020.240.14~1/RELEASE_X86_64
    Binaries:
      Node: 19.6.0
      npm: 9.4.0
      Yarn: 1.22.19
      pnpm: N/A
    Relevant packages:
      next: 12.3.1
      eslint-config-next: 12.3.1
      react: 17.0.2
      react-dom: 17.0.2
```

### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

* CLI (create-next-app) `next build`

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/0xadada/nextjs-detect-conflicts-slow

### To Reproduce

create a site that returns 200,000 dynamically generated pages

```javascript
// pages/[id].js
export const getStaticPaths = async () => {
  paths = [...(new Array(200000))].map((_i, x) => ({ params: { id: x }}))
  return {
    paths,
    fallback: false,
  };
};
```

`next build` will take a long time ~`1h 20m`, and eventually stop responding.



### Describe the Bug

During the build process, a Next app builds an array of paths for all of its pages, a [function called `detectConflictingPaths`](https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/next/src/build/utils.ts#L1558-L1590) iterates over those paths and checks for conflicts that would result in duplicate paths. If any conflicts are detected, it throws an error `Conflicting paths returned from getStaticPaths, paths must be unique per page` and exits the process.

During the build process, the CLI progress indicator reports "Collecting page data ..."

This function gets exponentially slower as the paths array increases:

- 100 paths `0.002461s`
- 200 paths `0.006019s`
- 400 paths `0.020899s`
- 800 paths `0.062096s`
- 1600 paths `0.224554s`
- 3200 paths `0.874216s`
- 6400 paths `3.370s`
- 12800 paths `14.280s` 💥 at this size, the CLI progress indicator stopped working
- 25600 paths `60.795s`
- 51200 paths `4m 01.98s`
- 102,400 paths  `14m 10.272`
- 204,800 paths `1.6h`




### Expected Behavior

`detectConflictingPaths` should not take more than a second to run.

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

irrelevant

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

next build && next export
